snippet.title: Hank Shaw: Animal Investigator Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
From Exit 73 Games, creators of #BLUD comes an all new noir mystery adventure!

When a pet goes missing, Hank Shaw's the detective to turn to. But when there's been a breakout at the zoo? You're going to need to do more than chat with low down dirty rats and stool pigeons. Call in every favor you got and get your hands dirty as you sniff out clues. It's up to you gumshoe!

Wish list on steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4666950/Hank_Shaw_Animal_Investigator/
